name: jjui-a0520167-blind30-ots
instr:
# jjui-regen

Working with a recent build of this keyboard-driven terminal front end for a version control system, I hit a scatter of misbehaviour that does not seem to share one cause. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. Below is everything I could reproduce, written as what I did and what came back.

Moving a highlight about and acting on whatever it sits under. In the panel that keeps previously issued instructions beside their output, with six entries recorded, the highlight starts on the newest and each press in either direction lands somewhere other than the neighbouring entry; an entry whose output spans several lines vanishes from what gets drawn while it is the highlighted one, neither its heading line nor any of its body appearing. Asking to remove the highlighted entry there does nothing: it stays in the visible list, it stays in the record behind the list, and the tally of live messages does not drop. Recall in the little field at the bottom is dead as well. With the as-you-type completion hint switched off, I open the prompt for running an external instruction, and pressing up in the field leaves it empty instead of bringing back something I ran earlier, while pressing down then yields that same text again rather than a neighbouring entry.
